info.title: mixed_intent_dialogue_samples
info.description:
![banner](https://proteus-prod-public.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/temp/79cd1149-9e76-4860-8c6d-412ebf492a55.png)

This dataset contains diverse prompt-completion pairs covering multiple domains, including structured JSON generation for vocabulary, casual conversation, and multilingual interactions. The samples illustrate varying levels of instruction adherence, showcasing both successful constraint satisfaction and instances where the model ignores formatting requirements. It serves as a resource for evaluating model performance on complex constraints, language switching, and contextual dialogue management.
info.userSpecifiedSources: Original data was supplied as user-uploaded files.
